skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find an appropriate common denominator and rewrite unlike-denominator fractions or fraction parts as equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fraction parts once they have a common denominator, including cases with zero numerators or zero fractional parts.

skills.name: Handle whole-number parts
skills.definition: Separate mixed or whole quantities into whole-number and fractional parts, subtract the whole-number parts, and recombine or retain the whole-number result with the fraction result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction parts
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as denominator-over-denominator fractions when the fractional minuend is too small to subtract the fractional subtrahend.

skills.name: Simplify fractional result
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms after subtraction.
